headline: 88 of 97 Omitted Voters Restored to Goa Electoral Rolls
summary: Out of 97 voters left off the electoral rolls in Goa, 88 have been reinstated after filing Form 6. The Election Commission noted that three others were excluded because they hold Portuguese citizenship.

headline: High Court Questions EC Over Removal of Six Names from Electoral Rolls
summary: The Bombay High Court has asked the Election Commission to explain a software glitch that led to the removal of six family members' names from Goa's electoral rolls. The court raised concerns over automated rejections without proper physical verification.

headline: High Court Questions Automated Rejections of Form 8
summary: The Bombay High Court has questioned the Election Commission of India over its automated system rejecting voter applications. The court emphasized that software errors cannot justify deleting voters without a proper hearing.

headline: Goa-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express Extended to Bengaluru
summary: The Vande Bharat Express service between Goa and Mangaluru will now extend its route up to Bengaluru. This extension aims to improve connectivity between Karnataka and Goa.

headline: Vande Bharat Extension to Boost Goa-Karnataka Rail Links
summary: The Madgaon-Mangaluru Vande Bharat train service is set to expand its route to Bengaluru. This decision is expected to significantly enhance rail travel and connectivity between the two states.

headline: Goa Vande Bharat Extended to Yesvantpur in Bengaluru
summary: The existing Vande Bharat Express from Goa to Mangaluru has been officially extended to Yesvantpur station in Bengaluru. Passengers can now check the updated schedule and list of stops for this route.

headline: Teenager Abducted Near School in Calangute
summary: A 14-year-old girl was reportedly kidnapped near her school in Calangute, Goa. Local authorities have initiated an investigation into the abduction.

headline: CBI Books Four Canara Bank Officials Over Multi-Crore Fraud
summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation has booked four Canara Bank officials and two others in relation to a multi-crore fixed deposit scam. The agency is looking into the alleged financial irregularities.

headline: Goa Nightclub Owners Offer Rs 15 Lakh Ex Gratia After Fatal Fire
summary: Owners of a Goa nightclub have offered compensation of Rs 15 lakh each to the families of individuals who lost their lives in a recent fire. The Bombay High Court has sought a reply regarding the matter.

headline: Diesel Tanker Falls Into Waterbody from Ferry at Adpai
summary: A diesel tanker fell off a private ferry and plunged into a waterbody in Adpai. Authorities are monitoring the situation to manage potential environmental impacts.

headline: Rosetta Hospitality Plans Rs 650 Crore Expansion in Goa and Other Regions
summary: Rosetta Hospitality has announced an investment of Rs 650 crore to expand its footprint in Goa, Sakleshpur, and Kalipura. This capital injection is aimed at growing its portfolio of luxury properties.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Relocates to Goa to Escape High Costs
summary: A couple spending Rs 1.3 lakh monthly in Bengaluru decided to move to Goa in search of a better lifestyle. They shared their reasons online, sparking discussions on urban living costs.

headline: CJP Plans Nationwide Protests Demanding Resignation of Gyanesh Kumar
summary: Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) has announced plans to hold protest marches in Goa, Bengaluru, and Kolkata. The group states the protests will continue until Gyanesh Kumar steps down from his post.

headline: Mock Drills Test Goa’s Disaster Preparedness
summary: Simulated emergency situations were conducted across Goa to evaluate the state's disaster response readiness. These mock drills helped identify operational strengths and areas of improvement for rescue agencies.

headline: South Goa Records Majority of September Dengue Cases
summary: Out of 66 confirmed dengue cases recorded in Goa during September, 63 were reported from the South Goa district. Health departments are taking measures to control vector-borne diseases in the affected zones.

headline: CEO Approves 88 Re-enrollment Applications for Omitted Voters
summary: Goa's Chief Electoral Officer confirmed that 88 out of the 97 voters omitted from the rolls have successfully submitted Form 6. Their applications have been accepted to restore their voting rights.

headline: Goa Cabinet Clears Special Purpose Vehicle for Water Metro
summary: The Goa state cabinet has approved the formation of a Special Purpose Vehicle to run the "Namo Tarang" water metro project. This decision paves the way for the implementation of the water transport initiative.

headline: High Court Declares Draft Rolls Insufficient to Delete Voters
summary: The Goa bench of the Bombay High Court ruled that voters' names cannot be removed solely based on a draft electoral roll. The court highlighted the necessity of providing affected individuals a proper hearing.

headline: TVS MotoSoul 6.0 Set for December in Goa
summary: The sixth edition of the TVS MotoSoul biking festival is scheduled to take place in Goa on December 11 and 12. The event promises to bring together motorcycle enthusiasts from across the country.

headline: 500-Year-Old Portuguese Decree Sparks Debate in Goa
summary: A 16th-century Portuguese decree has triggered fresh intellectual and historical debates in Goa as it marks its 500th anniversary. Critics and historians are examining its long-term social and cultural impacts on the state.

headline: Former MAD Host Rob Thrives Beyond Television Career
summary: Harun Robert, popularly known as Rob from the children's art show MAD, is reportedly earning more than ever through his modern creative ventures. He continues to engage with audiences via digital platforms and independent projects.

headline: 88 Voter Names Restored Following Goa SIR Controversy
summary: In the wake of the Goa Status of Information Report (SIR) controversy, 88 of the 97 missing voter cases have been successfully updated. These names have either been restored or approved for future inclusion in the electoral rolls.

headline: Goa Re-enrolls 88 Voters; Three Disqualified Over Portuguese Passports
summary: Election officials in Goa have restored 88 previously omitted voters to the electoral rolls. Meanwhile, three individuals were excluded after it was discovered they hold Portuguese passports.

headline: 88 Omitted Voters Replaced on Goa Lists Via Form 6
summary: The Chief Electoral Officer of Goa announced that 88 out of 97 voters who were left out after the SIR process have submitted Form 6. All 88 applications have been accepted for re-enlistment.

headline: Applications Accepted for 88 Omitted Voters in Goa
summary: Following disputes over the electoral roll updates, 88 affected citizens filed Form 6 to resolve their status. The Chief Electoral Officer confirmed their applications have been approved.

headline: High Court Reaffirms Voter Rights Amid Goa SIR Row
summary: The Bombay High Court has declared that draft rolls cannot be utilized to delete voters' names without giving them an opportunity to be heard. This ruling comes amid ongoing disputes surrounding the Goa SIR process.

headline: Goa CEO Updates Status of 97 Left-Out Voters
summary: The Chief Electoral Officer of Goa released an official status report addressing the 97 voters omitted from electoral lists. The report confirms that 88 applications filed under Form 6 have been accepted.

headline: Actor Aadesh Chaudhary Shares His Love for Goa
summary: Television actor Aadesh Chaudhary revealed in an interview that he has visited Goa more than 20 times. He described the coastal state as one of his favorite holiday destinations.

headline: Margao Bus Stand Project Delayed by Red Tape
summary: The tendering process for the development of the Margao bus stand remains stalled due to government administrative delays. Commuters continue to face inconvenience as the infrastructure upgrade is put on hold.

headline: Panaji and Porvorim SDPOs Swap Administrative Roles
summary: In a sudden administrative reshuffle, the Sub-Divisional Police Officers of Panaji and Porvorim have swapped their charges. The transfers were executed following an official government posting order.

headline: Senior Citizen Committees Defunct as Goa Celebrates Elders' Day
summary: Although Goa celebrated Elders' Day, the state's senior citizen panels have reportedly remained defunct since March 2025. This has drawn criticism regarding the actual support structures available for the elderly.

headline: EC Identifies Discrepancies in Goa Left-Out Voters List
summary: The Election Commission published a list detailing the status of 97 omitted voters in Goa. While 88 citizens had their Form 6 accepted, three were confirmed as Portuguese passport holders, making them ineligible.

headline: Goa's GST Collections Fall Short of Annual Target
summary: Goa's Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections have fallen 10% short of the state's annual target. Officials are analyzing the revenue gap and looking at ways to improve fiscal performance.

headline: Construction of Rs 641-Crore Porvorim Flyover Criticized
summary: The ongoing development of the Rs 641-crore flyover in Porvorim has faced heavy criticism for causing severe public inconvenience. The project has been highlighted as an example of poor road infrastructure planning in India.

headline: Goa Experiences Its Driest Monsoon in Five Decades
summary: Meteorological data reveals that Goa has recorded its driest monsoon season in 50 years. The lack of adequate rainfall raises concerns over water reserves and agricultural output in the state.

headline: Goa Records 31.7% Rainfall Deficit in 2026 Monsoon
summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) announced that Goa faced a 31.7% deficit in rainfall during the 2026 monsoon season. The lower-than-average precipitation has impacted various environmental sectors.

headline: Goa Clears Land for Affordable Housing Project in Parcem
summary: The Goa state government has approved land clearance for its first ever affordable housing project, to be situated in Parcem. This initiative aims to provide budget-friendly residential options for locals.

headline: Goa Government Appoints New President of Administrative Tribunal
summary: The state government has officially appointed a new president to head the Goa Administrative Tribunal. The appointment is expected to help resolve pending administrative disputes.

headline: Arpora House Destroyed by Fire; Family Safe
summary: A massive fire completely gutted a house in Arpora, but all family members managed to escape without injuries. Firefighters successfully brought the flames under control before they could spread.

headline: Coast Guard Evacuates Sick Sailor Off Goa Coast
summary: The Indian Coast Guard successfully rescued a critically ill sailor from a commercial merchant vessel operating off the Goa coast. The patient was safely evacuated and transferred to a medical facility for treatment.

headline: Union Agriculture Minister to Launch 'Goa Fresh' Brand
summary: The Union Minister for Agriculture is scheduled to officially launch the 'Goa Fresh' brand. The initiative aims to support local farmers and boost the distribution of fresh agricultural products.

headline: Goa's Charter Season Begins Early as First Russian Flight Arrives
summary: Goa's tourism charter season has kicked off ahead of schedule with the arrival of the first Russian flight carrying 126 tourists. Industry operators hope this early start signals a strong season ahead.

headline: Unstable Monsoon Season Threatens Goa's Agriculture
summary: Local farmers in Goa are facing severe challenges due to an unpredictable and erratic monsoon season. The unstable weather patterns have disrupted crop cycles and triggered concerns about overall yields.

headline: Special Drive Aims to Register First-Time and Omitted Voters
summary: Authorities are launching a special voter registration campaign in Goa to ensure no eligible citizens are left out. The drive will focus specifically on registering young, first-time voters and those omitted from past lists.

headline: Water Resources Department Taps Kushavati River to Save Reservoir
summary: The Water Resources Department has initiated a project to tap into the Kushavati River to conserve water levels at the Selaulim dam. This measure is intended to secure public water supply during drier periods.

headline: Tawadkar Promises ST Seat Reservations Prior to 2027 Elections
summary: Goa Assembly Speaker Ramesh Tawadkar has assured the Scheduled Tribes (ST) community that seat reservations will be implemented before the 2027 state elections. He stated that the government is actively working on the process.

headline: Union Minister Praises 'Swayampurna Goa' Scheme
summary: The Union Agriculture Minister praised the 'Swayampurna Goa' initiative, holding it up as a model program for national development. During his speech, he also criticized the opposition Congress party's ongoing political march.

headline: Treated Psychiatric Patients Face Rehabilitation Crisis in Goa
summary: A leading psychiatric facility in Goa is facing a major issue as recovered patients have nowhere to go after their treatment ends. The institute highlights a critical lack of family acceptance and proper rehabilitation centers.

headline: High Court Rebukes Election Commission Over Software Failure
summary: The Bombay High Court strongly criticized the Election Commission for relying on flawed software that deleted six members of a Santa Cruz family from the voter rolls. The court urged the use of human oversight to prevent such errors.

headline: Congress Criticizes Ruling Government During Tivim Event
summary: The Congress party launched a strong political attack against the ruling government during a gathering at Tivim. Opposition leaders raised concerns over regional administrative failures and developmental delays.
